questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

Statements:

Some villagers are farmers.

All businessmen are farmers.

Some city dwellers are businessmen.

Conclusions:

I. Some businessmen being villagers is a possibility.

II. Some villagers are city dwellers.

III. Some city dwellers are farmers.

options.text: Only conclusions II and III follow
Only conclusions I and II follow
All conclusions I, II and III follow
Only conclusions I and III follow

questions.solution:
__**Least possible Venn diagram**__:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cded3a9305596c3a0366a1ab354b52dff1f7539992aeb69269aa588ad73b0574.png] 

**Conclusions:**

**I. **Some businessmen being villagers is a possibility →** Follow** (As all businessmen are farmers and Some villagers are farmers so it is a possibility that Some businessmen are villagers).

This Possible scenario can be shown by the following Venn diagram:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cded3a9305596c3a0366a1ab354b52dff1f7539992aeb69269aa588ad73b0574.png] 

As we can see from this Venn diagram, some businessmen could be villagers.

**II.** Some villagers are city dwellers →** Doesn't Follow **(according to the given statements Some villagers are farmers, all businessmen are farmers, and Some city dwellers are businessmen. so we can't say that that Some villagers are city dwellers).

This Possible scenario can be shown by the following Venn diagram:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cded3a9305596c3a0366a1ab354b52dff1f7539992aeb69269aa588ad73b0574.png] 

As we can see from this Venn diagram, some villagers could be city dwellers.

**III.** Some city dwellers are farmers → **Follow** (As some city dwellers are businessmen and all businessmen are farmers. so Some city dwellers are definitely farmers)

Hence, the correct answer is** "Only conclusions I and III follow"**.

questions.question:
If ‘P’ means ‘addition’, ‘Q’ means ‘subtraction’, ‘R’ means ‘multiplication’, and ‘S‘ means ‘division’. What will be the value of the following expression?

76 P 42 S 6 Q 22 P (8 R 15)
questions.solution:
Here, we use the BODMAS table:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a18f8b3ef4fc34858fbd9e7b24698870c03ce02210b094a7b4bf7c9b683e361f.png] 

**Given:**

⇒ 76 P 42 S 6 Q 22 P (8 R 15)

As per the given data:

 
 

 **Symbol**
 **Means**
 
 

 P
 Addition (+)
 
 

 Q
 Subtraction (-)
 
 

 R
 Multiplication (×)
 
 

 S
 Division (÷)
 
 

After interchanging the alphabet with signs:

⇒ 76 + 42 ÷ 6 - 22 + __**(8 × 15)**__

Apply BODMAS rule:

⇒ 76 + __**42 ÷ 6**__ - 22 + 120

⇒ 76 + 7 - 22 + 120

⇒ 203 - 22 = 181

Here, the value of the equation is** '181'.**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option (3)".

questions.question:
Two statements I and II are given. These statements can be independent causes, or effects of independent causes, or effects of a common cause. One statement can be the effect of another statement. Read both statements and choose the correct alternative.

**Statement I: **People have been appealed to assist in the contribution of clothes and indestructible items for the flood victims in the region.

**Statement II: **The floods have damaged houses and caused complete disruption in the area.

options.text: II is the cause and I is its effect.
Both I and II are independent causes.
Both I and II are effects of independent causes.
I is the cause and II is its effect.

questions.solution:
⇒ **Statement II c**learly describes that the floods have damaged houses and caused complete disruption in the area.

⇒ **Statement I** tries to explain that the flood-affected people, as mentioned in S**tatement II,** must be helped or assisted by the contribution of clothes and indestructible items for the flood victims in that area.

So, **Statement I **is the effect of **Statement II, **and **Statement II **is its cause.

Hence, the correct answer is "**option (1)".**

questions.question:
Which two signs should be interchanged to make the below equation mathematically correct?

35 + 21 - 168 ÷ 28 × 7 = 154
questions.solution:
The given equation 35 + 21 - 168 ÷ 28 × 7 = 154

**Option 1) - and + **

After interchanging - and +

35 - 21 + 168 ÷ 28 - 7

= 35 - 21 + 6 - 7

= 41 - 28

= 13 ≠ 154

**Option 2) + and ÷ **

After interchanging + and ÷

35 ÷ 21 - 168 + 28 × 7

= 1.666 - 168 + 196

= -166.333 + 196

= 29.66667 ≈ 30 ≠ 154

**Option 3) × and -**

After interchanging × and -

35 + 21 × 168 ÷ 28 - 7

= 35 + 21 × 6 - 7

= 35 + 126 - 7

= 161 - 7

**= 154 (correct)**

Option 4) ÷ and -

After interchanging ÷ and -

35 + 21 ÷ 168 - 28 × 7 = 154 

= 35 + 0.125 - 672 ≠ 154

Hence the correct answer is** "option 3".**

questions.question: If 1st August 2009 was a Saturday, then what was the day of the week on 1st August 2013?
questions.solution:
In any two consecutive ordinary years, date of the next year will be one day ahead of the same date of the previous year.

1st August 2009 = Saturday

1st August 2010 = Sunday

1st August 2011 = Monday

If a leap year comes immediately after an ordinary year, then the day on a certain date of the leap year will be 2 days ahead of the same date on the ordinary year from March to December.

1st August 2012 = Wednesday

1st August 2013 = Thursday

Hence, the correct answer is **option(2)**

questions.question:
Select the option that is related to the fifth number in the same way as the second number is related to the first number and the fourth number is related to the third number.

(NOTE: Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into its constituent digits. EXAMPLE: 13 - Operations on 13 such as adding/subtracting/multiplying etc. to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed)

3 : 16 :: 5 : 36 :: 7 : ?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is :-

**(First Term + 1)² = Second Term**

In 3 : 16 → (3 + 1)² = 16

In 5 : 36 → (5 + 1)² = 36

Similarly,

**In 7 : 64 → (7 + 1)² = 64**

Hence, the correct answer is **"64".**
